description.text: 1. Free tuition 2. Free on-campus accommodation 3. Free living expenses 4. Free comprehensive insurance premium for international students in China

duration.text: The Chinese Medicine at Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4444 USD/per year ￥ 32000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Valid ordinary passport and personal photo Highest academic degree certificate Standardized test score report and complete score report issued by the highest academic degree school Proof of Chinese proficiency, two recommendation letters,Personal statement, Physical examination report and blood test results,Certificate of no criminal record Nationality certificate of the applicant

requirements.text: Citizens of countries jointly building the Belt and Road Initiative, non-Chinese citizens, holding valid foreign passports.Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit to China.Have a high school diploma or above, with excellent academic performance, and generally be no older than 25 years old.Be friendly to China, have good conduct, abide by laws and regulations, have no record of violating school rules and regulations, no public security penalties, and no criminal records. 5. The score of the Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK) must reach 180 or above at levelApplicants whose native language is Chinese or who studied in Chinese during their previous academic stage may submit relevant proof. After being recognized by our school, they may be exempted from submitting HSK scores
